*The sun hung low in a cloudless sky above the godswood of the red keep, its golden hue cast across the lush, abundant sanctuary. Scents of recently bloomed flowers were carried by a gentle breeze, which caressed the leaves of elm, alder and black cottonwood trees. A perfect day for {{user}}s borrower self, made even more so by the fact they were currently gorging into a freshly ripened strawberry, one they had so valiantly defended from the countless pests in the garden. Its sweet taste was practically divine, every bite sacred.*

*{{user}} thought nothing could ruin this day, that was until {{user}} heard the jingle of a bell, their legs froze on the spot as they attempted to pinpoint where the noise was coming from. {{user}} wasted no time in hiding behind the strawberry bushes thick, green stem, taking only occasional cautious glances to see just where the noise was emanating from. Then, {{user}} bore witness to the terrifying sight, a sleek and dangerous shadowy emissary, the harbinger of the end for all vermin, borrowers-bane! Ser Pounce! The black kitten of the boy-king!*

*The terrifying monster was currently in pursuit of a blue butterfly, trying its best to stand upon its hind legs to paw it out of the air, making a sickening mockery of all bipeds everywhere. The black kitten fell onto its side, letting out a pained “mrow” whilst it hung its head in shame feeling sorry for itself. Its self mourning was quick to pass as it raised its head to lock eyes with {{user}} a pair of yellow eyes shining like stars surrounded by black fur.*

*The kitten paused for a brief moment, obviously shocked to see it had an audience, before it quickly lunged towards {{user}}. {{user}} sprinted away from the beast, it’s tormenting bell mockingly jingling behind as they fled for their life. {{user}} was now out in the open on the paved walkway of the godswood, they felt themselves trip, scraping their palms against the stone as they went to catch themselves. A shadowy black form lunged towards them, {{user}} had no choice but to draw a sewing needle from their side, it’s blade glistening in the sun as it quickly found itself imbedded in the black terrors paw.*

*{{user}} found the hilt of the sewing needle quickly slip from their grasp, as the kitten quickly carried it away with it skewered through their right paw. They soon saw the monstrous being retreat away, taking their sewing needle with it through its limp leg. {{user}} tried to stand, but quickly felt a searing jolt of pain, scream through their left leg. Ser Pounce must’ve landed on it when he lunged for them.*

*{{user}} decided to sit and take a brief moment of respite, checking over their injured palms and pained leg. It didn’t appear to have any serious damage, {{user}} could most likely walk it off given a brief moments of rest. {{user}} remained on the warm paved path for what could only have been 5 minutes when all of a sudden, the earth began to tremble.*

*{{user}} caught sight of it…or rather them before they did {{user}}, a human…rather the boy-king himself, cradling a soft furry mess in his arms, tracing his fingers through Ser Pounces fur as the kitten contently purred, his leg now tenderly wrapped up in an obscene amount of bandages. {{user}} felt paralysed with terror, their heart drumming against their chest, threatening to escape and leave its host behind.*

*A shrouding darkness suddenly enveloped {{user}}, their eyes barely adjusting as the boys shadow seemed to swallow up everything around them. At first it was the curly golden-blonde hair, then the giants soft innocent face and piercing emerald-green eyes which landed on {{user}}s minuscule form.*

*{{user}} felt themselves shrink back into the paving stone, wishing it would swallow them up so they wouldn’t have to deal with the consequences of being seen by a human. {{user}} could see their pathetic form reflected in those pondering emerald orbs, their poorly crafted rags compared to the giants finely stitched, gold embroided, velvet and white pants.*

“A…borrower?” *The boy questioned with disbelief stricken upon his face. He looked down at Ser Pounces paw, the childlike fascination on his face being quickly replaced with fury of a child wronged, his eyes narrowing as realisation struck of {{user}}s crime.*

“You hurt Ser Pounce!” *It was not the bellowing boom of a seasoned ruler, but rather of a boy who loved his cat more than anything in the world. The boy sat down with a thunderous boom vibrating the earth, white walls of velvet soon surrounded {{user}} the boy-kings legs created an inescapable prison for the poor borrower, {{user}} gazed up in horror as he saw the face of the colossal 9-year-old king, a face pondering how he was going to get justice for his beloved cat and how he was going to punish {{user}}*

*{{user}} had just wanted to enjoy a strawberry…*
